% Labels
\newcommand{\chip}[2]{{\setlength{\fboxsep}{2pt}\colorbox{#1}{\color{white}\footnotesize\bfseries\strut\,#2\,}}}
\newcommand{\dotc}[1]{\textcolor{#1}{\large\textbullet}}
\newcommand{\dotR}{\dotc{cred}}
\newcommand{\dotA}{\dotc{camber}}
\newcommand{\dotG}{\dotc{cgreen}}
\newcommand{\result}[1]{\ifstrequal{#1}{RED}{\chip{cred}{Action needed}}{\ifstrequal{#1}{AMBER}{\chip{camber}{Check again}}{\chip{cgreen}{No problem found}}}}
\newcommand{\zone}[1]{\ifstrequal{#1}{KEEP OUT}{\chip{cred}{Keep out}}{\ifstrequal{#1}{RESTRICTED}{\chip{camber}{Restricted}}{\ifstrequal{#1}{LOW GAMMA}{\chip{cgreen}{Low gamma}}{\chip{cgrey}{Not checked}}}}}
